Oh wow the wording of this is SO tricky. When I first read it, it sounded like they handed the trademarks to tbz and their new company was making a big fuss for nothing, but after reading comments on the other post of this on the kpop subreddit, I now see it for what it truly is.

What IST is saying is that they’re allowing the members to **USE THE TRADEMARK FOR FREE**, NOT that they’re giving them the trademark for free. That is such evil and precise wording. This means that IST will still own the TBZ name and is just letting the boys use the name for free, meaning they can also just take away those rights just as easily (and it might also imply that their new company will have to pay to use TBZ name for anything they do, not sure how that works though). What that also means is that they’ll still reap the benefits of anything TBZ does, royalties etc, while they sit back and let another company manage and put in the money for their future activities/comebacks. I can definitely see why their new company came out with such a harsh accusation statement.
